name: 12563-jsonschema-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1). SM90, CUDA 12.x.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params (16.1 GB); the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 8, bounded at 320 requests / 900 s safety, first 25% discarded as warmup.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt exactly 128 tokens, output exactly 256, and the same JSON schema attached to every request. The schema is declared as `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.json` in `configs/scenario.json` and handed to the engine as its own structured-output parameter; `ignore_eos` is forced, so a request emits 256 tokens whether or not the document has closed; temperature 0.0.
purpose: A JSON-emitting data extraction service on one GPU, eight concurrent users, short prompts, fixed 256-token schema-conforming replies.
launch:
# FLAT YAML ONLY: the loader takes this file line by line and skips any line starting with a
# space, so a block-style mapping parses to nothing and the engine starts silently without it.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
